title: How to (Accidentally) Spot an Islamabad University Student. Tip #1
body: Ask the university and then ask nothing else, because he will tell you the ranking unprompted. NUST says NUST within ninety seconds. QAU says it with a specific kind of pride. FAST and COMSATS have a rivalry nobody outside understands. Bahria and Air get mentioned with a small joke attached to get ahead of it. It's a sealed deal if he still remembers his NET score and brings it up years later.
caption:
Tip #1 😭 NUST, QAU, FAST, COMSATS, you're all in here.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot an Islamabad University Student. Tip #2
body: Watch the semester rhythm. Weeks one to six nothing happens. Week seven is midterms and panic. Then nothing until the last two weeks, when the entire degree happens at once, fuelled by chai and a shared Google Doc. It's a sealed deal if he has ever done a full semester's reading in one night and passed.
caption:
Tip #2 😭 NUST, QAU, FAST, COMSATS, you're all in here.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot an Islamabad University Student. Tip #3
body: Ask about attendance. Seventy-five percent is the law and everyone is running a deficit. There is one friend who signs the sheet for four people. There is one teacher whose class nobody has attended since September and one whose class nobody dares miss. It's a sealed deal if he knows his exact percentage per course and it's the only number he tracks.
caption:
Tip #3 😭 NUST, QAU, FAST, COMSATS, you're all in here.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot an Islamabad University Student. Tip #4
body: Find out where he eats. The cafeteria if broke, the dhaba outside if slightly less broke, and one chai spot where a cup lasts three hours and counts as studying. Nobody at that table is studying. It's a sealed deal if the group has a specific table and someone gets genuinely upset when it's occupied.
caption:
Tip #4 😭 NUST, QAU, FAST, COMSATS, you're all in here.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot an Islamabad University Student. Tip #5
body: Ask where he's from, because the hostel divide is the real divide. The Islamabad kid goes home for lunch. The hostelite is from Multan or Swat or Gilgit, sends money logic in reverse, goes home twice a year, and works harder than everyone. It's a sealed deal if he says his city and then immediately explains where it is before anyone asks.
caption:
Tip #5 😭 NUST, QAU, FAST, COMSATS, you're all in here.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot an Islamabad University Student. Tip #6
body: Ask about the semester project. There is a group. There are five names on it and two people who did it. Everyone knows who the two are and nobody says it in the presentation. It's a sealed deal if he has ever been the one who did it and still gets asked for the file years later.
caption:
Tip #6 😭 NUST, QAU, FAST, COMSATS, you're all in here.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot an Islamabad University Student. Tip #7
body: Ask what happens after. Master's abroad, a software house, family business, or CSS, and most people hold all four open because choosing one means admitting the rest are gone. He'll say "dekhtay hain" and change the subject. It's a sealed deal if his mother has a clearer plan for his life than he does and has already told you about it.
caption:
